unchanged: All normalization, coefficients, eligibility and ranking vectors in task-lexical-v1.json remain fixed.
candidate_predicate: All records in the selected generation satisfying the existing hard environment and kind filters, BEFORE any text matching. No FTS preselection in task mode.
native_retrieval: Current-generation membership joined to row_json, existing hard SQL filters, ASCII ID ordering, LIMIT 513. Strict all_terms FTS is unchanged.
overflow: query_too_broad on every engine when more than512 hard-filtered records remain. Narrow runtime, robot, kind or other hard filters; adding text alone does not reduce this bound. Never silently truncate or fall back.
scope_limitation: Unfiltered whole-catalog task search can exceed512 records. This is an explicit v1 resource bound, not a complete-catalog ranked result.
pagination: Score the complete bounded hard-filtered set before pagination; preserve query_mode and exact generation in next-page arguments.
